items.t: Rear suspension link bracket rusting off the frame (recall)
items.job: Inspect, coat or reinforce rear lower link brackets
items.note: Free under the recall when it was done in time. If rust is too far gone, the recall offered a buyback instead.
Owners report $2,400 to $3,800 for rebuilds and replacements. A used transmission is cheaper.

items.t: Fuel leak at the fuel pump, fire risk (recall)
items.job: Install new fuel pump feed port cover or new pump
items.note: Recall applied to SUVs registered in TX, OK, AR, NM and LA. Elsewhere, a leaking pump is a paid fuel pump replacement.

items.t: Sudden stalling or loss of power while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling and replace fuel pump if it is the cause
items.note: If a sensor is to blame instead, the repair is usually cheaper.

items.t: Direct-injection fuel injector failure or clogging
items.note: A cleaning may fix clogged injectors for much less. Replacement prices vary widely.

items.t: Engine jumps timing and bends valves
items.job: Cylinder head repair with timing parts
items.note: A used engine may cost about the same.

items.t: Brake vibration and repeated rotor replacement
items.job: Replace brake pads and rotors (one axle)

items.t: ABS light on or brakes grabbing on slick roads
items.job: Diagnose ABS; replace wheel speed sensor or ABS module
items.note: A wheel speed sensor is at the low end and the ABS module at the high end.
Driveshaft or U-joint replacement costs more.

items.job: Change rear differential oil with limited-slip additive

items.t: Oil leaks and high oil use
items.job: Find and reseal engine oil leak
items.note: Based on an oil pan gasket job. Other gaskets cost more or less to reach, and oil burning inside the engine is not fixed by gaskets.

items.t: Clacking noise for a few minutes after a cold start
items.note: Price covers checking the oil and finding the source; parts beyond that are extra.

items.t: Passenger airbag may not inflate properly (recall)
Roof padding upgrade for head protection (recall)
